description: Create a saved Replo artifact, including Insights reports, from instructions, existing reports, analytics, or files. The agent follows the artifacts skill and uses its Insights reports guidance when analytics are needed. Starts an asynchronous internal-agent operation using normal Replo tools and connected integrations. Poll get_agent_session; its final message contains the saved artifact folder ID and viewer link after validation. Use the same tool with sessionId for follow-up instructions. Reuse operationId only for an identical retry. Creation is private by default; when the user asks to share the result, call set_file_sharing with its artifact folder ID. The result is an HTML artifact in Files; Insights reports are embedded inside it. Asking a question alone does not require creating anything.

instructions.description: Requested changes for this operation only. Include necessary references, not conversation history, credentials, or unrelated personal data.

operationId.description: Generate a fresh UUID for each new instruction. Reuse it with identical arguments on a retry to avoid duplicate work.

sessionId.description: Omit to start this operation. To continue, supply the returned sessionId with the same operation and target; mismatches and legacy sessions are rejected.

sources.description: Optional existing reports, analytics SQL, or Files documents. The agent reads and queries these sources. For standalone artifacts, omit sources and provide instructions.

scope.description: Override selected report defaults. Filters replace the default filter list; omitted fields retain the report's defaults.

isProjectDefault.description: Marks an automatically seeded project domain, not a viewer selection.

name: create_artifact
title: Create artifact
